description: Play a video file or URL. URLs from supported streaming sites (YouTube, Bilibili, Twitch, Vimeo, etc.) are extracted via the bundled yt-dlp before playback.

file.description: Path to a local video file, or HTTP(S) URL to a streaming site.

proxy.description: Optional proxy URL forwarded to yt-dlp for URL extraction (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890)

name: play
